capabilities: Run TypeScript, shell and AI cells in Markdown notes
Execute each code cell in its own container
Write cell outputs back under the cell
Read and write vault notes from workflows
Schedule workflows with cron while Obsidian is open
extras: Desktop only; every run needs a running container engine, even AI-only workflows; the CLI is not on npm yet.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot execute code or AI prompts, so workflows that read and write notes must be run outside the vault.

relations.evidence: AI cells send their prompt to api.openai.com or api.anthropic.com, with your API key
call OpenAI or Anthropic with your own key
Docker, Podman, Colima (macOS), or Apple container (macOS 26+, Apple silicon).
vaultore schedules export writes the manifest that hands scheduled workflows to CronAI

requires.name: Container engine (Docker, Podman, Colima, or Apple container)
OpenAI or Anthropic account with paid API access

summary: Workflow runner that executes TypeScript, shell and AI cells in Markdown notes inside containers and writes results back under each cell.
